files.text:
' SIEGE - an alien invasion shooter for the ZX Spectrum Next, in NTC BASIC (VB5 flavour)
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' Straight to the Next's hardware, no ROM, no OS: the tilemap (Tiles.cls) draws the stars, the
' shields, the ground and the text; the hardware sprites (Spr.cls) are the aliens, the cannon,
' the shots; the AY (Sfx.cls) the sound. The art is in gfx/ - swap it with gfxtool.js.
'
' Keys: O / P or 5 / 8 (cursor left / right) move, Space / M / 0 fire. Kempston joystick too.
Option Explicit
Option Turbo

Const NCOL = 11, NROW = 5, NAL = 55
Const ADX = 18, ADY = 16             ' the formation's spacing
Const PY = 224                       ' the cannon's sprite y
Const SROW = 24                      ' the shields' top row (tiles 24-26)
Const GROW = 30                      ' the ground's row
Const SL_PLAYER = 55, SL_SHOT = 56, SL_BOMB = 57, SL_SAUCER = 60, SL_BOOM = 61, SL_ICON = 62

Dim alive(54) As Byte
Dim fx As Integer, fy As Integer, fdir As Integer, ftimer As Integer, fanim As Integer
Dim nalive As Integer, mincol As Integer, maxcol As Integer, maxrow As Integer
Dim px As Integer, pdead As Integer, lives As Integer, wave As Integer, over As Integer
Dim score As Long, hiscore As Long, nextlife As Long
Dim sx As Integer, sy As Integer, son As Integer
Dim bx(2) As Integer, by(2) As Integer, bon(2) As Integer, banim As Integer
Dim ux As Integer, uon As Integer, udir As Integer, utimer As Integer
Dim boomx As Integer, boomy As Integer, boomt As Integer, msgt As Integer, msgx As Integer
Dim firewas As Integer, note As Integer, frames As Integer, seed As Integer
Dim i As Integer, j As Integer, k As Integer

Nx.Border 0
Tiles.Init
Spr.Init
GfxData.Load
Sfx.Init
Nx.Layers Nx.OrderSLU
hiscore = 1000
Do
  Title
  Play
  GameOver
Loop

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- input
Function KLeft() As Integer
  KLeft = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyLeft) Or ((Keys.Joystick(0) And Keys.JoyLeft) <> 0)
End Function

Function KRight() As Integer
  KRight = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyRight) Or ((Keys.Joystick(0) And Keys.JoyRight) <> 0)
End Function

Function KFire() As Integer
  KFire = Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyM) Or Keys.Down(Keys.Key0) Or ((Keys.Joystick(0) And Keys.JoyFire1) <> 0)
End Function

' fire pressed now and not last time
Function FirePressed() As Integer
  Dim f As Integer
  f = KFire()
  FirePressed = f And Not firewas
  firewas = f
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the screen
Sub Stars()
  Dim n As Integer
  Tiles.Fill 0
  For n = 1 To 70
    Tiles.Put Rnd(40), 3 + Rnd(20), GfxData.T_STAR + Rnd(3)
  Next
  Tiles.Rect 0, GROW, 40, 2, GfxData.T_GROUND
  Tiles.Rect 0, GROW, 40, 1, GfxData.T_GROUNDTOP
End Sub

Sub Shields()
  Dim n As Integer, c As Integer
  For n = 0 To 3
    c = 6 + n * 8
    Tiles.Rect c, SROW, 4, 3, GfxData.T_SHIELD
    Tiles.Put c + 1, SROW + 2, 0
    Tiles.Put c + 2, SROW + 2, 0
  Next
End Sub

Sub Hud()
  Dim i As Integer
  Tiles.Text 1, 1, "SCORE " & Format$(score, "000000")
  Tiles.Text 16, 1, "HI " & Format$(hiscore, "000000")
  Tiles.Text 28, 1, "WAVE " & Format$(wave, "00")
  Tiles.Rect 35, 1, 4, 1, 0
  For i = 1 To lives - 1
    If i < 5 Then Tiles.Put 34 + i, 1, GfxData.T_LIFE
  Next
End Sub

' a big word in logo blocks: 3 x 5 letters, each a row of bits
Sub BigText(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String, ByVal colour As Integer)
  Dim n As Integer, r As Integer, b As Integer, bits As Integer, ch As String
  For n = 1 To Len(s)
    ch = Mid$(s, n, 1)
    For r = 0 To 4
      bits = Glyph(ch, r)
      For b = 0 To 2
        If bits And (4 \ (2 ^ b)) Then
          Tiles.Put x + b, y + r, GfxData.T_LOGO + colour
        End If
      Next
    Next
    x = x + 4
  Next
End Sub

' the rows of a 3 x 5 letter (bit 2 = left)
Function Glyph(ByVal ch As String, ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
  Dim p As String
  Select Case ch
    Case "S": p = "74717"
    Case "I": p = "72227"
    Case "E": p = "74647"
    Case "G": p = "74557"
    Case "A": p = "25755"
    Case "M": p = "57555"
    Case "O": p = "75557"
    Case "V": p = "55552"
    Case "R": p = "75654"
    Case "W": p = "55575"
    Case Else: p = "00000"
  End Select
  Glyph = Val(Mid$(p, r + 1, 1))
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the title
Sub Title()
  Spr.HideRange 0, 64
  Stars
  BigText 10, 4, "SIEGE", 0
  Tiles.Text 11, 11, "DEFEND THE GROUND"
  Spr.Put 0, 112, 104, GfxData.S_SAUCER, 0
  Tiles.Text 17, 13, "= ??? MYSTERY"
  Spr.Put 1, 112, 120, GfxData.S_ALIENA, Spr.Pal * 3
  Tiles.Text 17, 15, "= 30 POINTS"
  Spr.Put 2, 112, 136, GfxData.S_ALIENB, Spr.Pal * 1
  Tiles.Text 17, 17, "= 20 POINTS"
  Spr.Put 3, 112, 152, GfxData.S_ALIENC, Spr.Pal * 2
  Tiles.Text 17, 19, "= 10 POINTS"
  Tiles.Text 6, 23, "O P  5 8  MOVE   SPACE  FIRE"
  Tiles.Text 10, 26, "PRESS FIRE TO START"
  Tiles.Text 1, 1, "SCORE " & Format$(score, "000000")
  Tiles.Text 16, 1, "HI " & Format$(hiscore, "000000")
  Tiles.Text 7, 28, "NTC BASIC  ZX SPECTRUM NEXT"
  frames = 0
  firewas = -1
  Do
    Frame
    Spr.Show
    Sfx.Update
    frames = frames + 1
    seed = seed + 1
    k = (frames \ 16) And 1
    Spr.Put 1, 112, 120, GfxData.S_ALIENA + k, Spr.Pal * 3
    Spr.Put 2, 112, 136, GfxData.S_ALIENB + k, Spr.Pal * 1
    Spr.Put 3, 112, 152, GfxData.S_ALIENC + k, Spr.Pal * 2
    If (frames And 31) = 0 Then Tiles.Text 10, 26, "PRESS FIRE TO START"
    If (frames And 31) = 20 Then Tiles.Text 10, 26, "                   "
  Loop Until FirePressed()
  Nx.Seed seed
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- a game
Sub Play()
  score = 0 : lives = 3 : wave = 1 : over = 0 : nextlife = 1500
  NewWave
  Do
    Frame
    Spr.Show
    Sfx.Update
    frames = frames + 1
    If pdead > 0 Then
      PlayerDying
    Else
      MovePlayer
      MoveShot
      StepFormation
      MoveBombs
      DropBombs
    End If
    MoveSaucer
    Effects
    If nalive = 0 And pdead = 0 Then
      wave = wave + 1
      NewWave
    End If
  Loop Until over
End Sub

Sub NewWave()
  Dim n As Integer
  Spr.HideRange 0, 64
  Stars
  Shields
  For n = 0 To NAL - 1
    alive(n) = 1
  Next
  nalive = NAL : mincol = 0 : maxcol = NCOL - 1 : maxrow = NROW - 1
  n = wave - 1
  If n > 5 Then n = 5
  fx = 40 : fy = 40 + n * 8 : fdir = 2 : ftimer = 1 : fanim = 0
  px = 152 : pdead = 0 : son = 0 : uon = 0 : utimer = 600 + Rnd(600)
  For n = 0 To 2
    bon(n) = 0
  Next
  boomt = 0 : msgt = 0
  Hud
  DrawFormation
  Spr.Put SL_PLAYER, px, PY, GfxData.S_PLAYER, 0
  ' "WAVE n" for a moment
  Tiles.Text 16, 16, "WAVE " & Format$(wave, "00")
  For n = 1 To 90
    Frame
    Spr.Show
    Sfx.Update
  Next
  Tiles.Text 16, 16, "        "
End Sub

' every alien's sprite where the formation is now
Sub DrawFormation()
  Dim r As Integer, c As Integer, n As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer, pat As Integer, fl As Integer
  n = 0
  y = fy
  For r = 0 To NROW - 1
    Select Case r
      Case 0: pat = GfxData.S_ALIENA : fl = Spr.Pal * 3
      Case 1, 2: pat = GfxData.S_ALIENB : fl = Spr.Pal * 1
      Case Else: pat = GfxData.S_ALIENC : fl = Spr.Pal * 2
    End Select
    pat = pat + fanim
    x = fx
    For c = 0 To NCOL - 1
      If alive(n) Then Spr.Put n, x, y, pat, fl
      n = n + 1
      x = x + ADX
    Next
    y = y + ADY
  Next
End Sub

Sub StepFormation()
  Dim drop As Integer, edge As Integer
  ftimer = ftimer - 1
  If ftimer > 0 Then Exit Sub
  ftimer = nalive \ 4 + 1
  drop = 0
  If fdir > 0 Then
    edge = fx + maxcol * ADX + 16 + fdir
    If edge > 312 Then drop = 1
  Else
    edge = fx + mincol * ADX + fdir
    If edge < 8 Then drop = 1
  End If
  If drop Then
    fy = fy + 8
    fdir = -fdir
  Else
    fx = fx + fdir
  End If
  fanim = 1 - fanim
  ' the march: four notes going down
  Sfx.Play 2, 700 + note * 90, 0, 11, 4, 0
  note = (note + 1) And 3
  DrawFormation
  ' low enough to eat the shields, or to land
  If fy + maxrow * ADY + 14 >= SROW * 8 Then EatShields
  If fy + maxrow * ADY + 13 >= PY + 2 Then
    over = 1
    Sfx.Play 1, 20, 1, 15, 60, 1
  End If
End Sub

' the bottom row of aliens wipes out the shield bricks it touches
Sub EatShields()
  Dim c As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer, t As Integer, n As Integer, dx As Integer, dy As Integer
  y = fy + maxrow * ADY
  For c = mincol To maxcol
    n = maxrow * NCOL + c
    If alive(n) Then
      x = fx + c * ADX
      For dy = 2 To 14 Step 6
        For dx = 1 To 15 Step 7
          t = Tiles.At(x + dx, y + dy)
          If t >= GfxData.T_SHIELD And t < GfxData.T_SHIELD + 4 Then Tiles.Put (x + dx) \ 8, (y + dy) \ 8, 0
        Next
      Next
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Sub MovePlayer()
  If KLeft() And px > 8 Then px = px - 2
  If KRight() And px < 296 Then px = px + 2
  Spr.Put SL_PLAYER, px, PY, GfxData.S_PLAYER, 0
  If FirePressed() And son = 0 Then
    son = 1 : sx = px : sy = PY - 8
    Sfx.Play 0, 60, 6, 12, 10, 0
  End If
End Sub

Sub MoveShot()
  Dim tx As Integer, ty As Integer, c As Integer, r As Integer, n As Integer, t As Integer, b As Integer
  If son = 0 Then Exit Sub
  sy = sy - 6
  tx = sx + 7 : ty = sy + 4
  If ty < 16 Then
    son = 0 : Spr.Hide SL_SHOT : Exit Sub
  End If
  ' a shield
  t = Tiles.At(tx, ty)
  If t >= GfxData.T_SHIELD And t < GfxData.T_SHIELD + 4 Then
    Damage tx, ty, t
    son = 0 : Spr.Hide SL_SHOT : Exit Sub
  End If
  ' an alien
  If tx >= fx And ty >= fy Then
    c = (tx - fx) \ ADX : r = (ty - fy) \ ADY
    If c < NCOL And r < NROW Then
      n = r * NCOL + c
      If alive(n) And tx - fx - c * ADX <= 14 And ty - fy - r * ADY <= 13 Then
        KillAlien n, c, r
        son = 0 : Spr.Hide SL_SHOT : Exit Sub
      End If
    End If
  End If
  ' the saucer
  If uon Then
    If tx >= ux + 1 And tx <= ux + 14 And ty >= 20 And ty <= 30 Then
      HitSaucer
      son = 0 : Spr.Hide SL_SHOT : Exit Sub
    End If
  End If
  ' a bomb
  For b = 0 To 2
    If bon(b) Then
      If Abs(tx - bx(b) - 7) <= 2 And ty >= by(b) + 4 And ty <= by(b) + 14 Then
        bon(b) = 0 : Spr.Hide SL_BOMB + b
        son = 0 : Spr.Hide SL_SHOT
        Boom bx(b), by(b)
        Exit Sub
      End If
    End If
  Next
  Spr.Put SL_SHOT, sx, sy, GfxData.S_SHOT, 0
End Sub

Sub Damage(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  If t = GfxData.T_SHIELD + 3 Then
    Tiles.Put x \ 8, y \ 8, 0
  Else
    Tiles.Put x \ 8, y \ 8, t + 1
  End If
End Sub

Sub KillAlien(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal c As Integer, ByVal r As Integer)
  Dim m As Integer
  alive(n) = 0
  Spr.Hide n
  nalive = nalive - 1
  Select Case r
    Case 0: AddScore 30
    Case 1, 2: AddScore 20
    Case Else: AddScore 10
  End Select
  Boom fx + c * ADX, fy + r * ADY
  Sfx.Play 1, 6, 1, 14, 14, 1
  ' the formation's edges now
  mincol = NCOL : maxcol = -1 : maxrow = -1
  For m = 0 To NAL - 1
    If alive(m) Then
      c = m Mod NCOL : r = m \ NCOL
      If c < mincol Then mincol = c
      If c > maxcol Then maxcol = c
      If r > maxrow Then maxrow = r
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Sub AddScore(ByVal n As Integer)
  score = score + n
  If score >= nextlife Then
    nextlife = nextlife + 1500
    If lives < 5 Then lives = lives + 1
    Sfx.Play 0, 100, -4, 15, 30, 0
  End If
  If score > hiscore Then hiscore = score
  Hud
End Sub

Sub Boom(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  boomx = x : boomy = y : boomt = 12
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the bombs
Sub DropBombs()
  Dim b As Integer, c As Integer, r As Integer, n As Integer, rate As Integer
  rate = 3 + wave
  If Rnd(100) >= rate Then Exit Sub
  For b = 0 To 2
    If bon(b) = 0 Then Exit For
  Next
  If b > 2 Then Exit Sub
  ' a column: half the time the one over the cannon
  If Rnd(2) = 0 Then
    c = (px + 8 - fx) \ ADX
    If c < 0 Or c >= NCOL Then c = mincol + Rnd(maxcol - mincol + 1)
  Else
    c = mincol + Rnd(maxcol - mincol + 1)
  End If
  For r = NROW - 1 To 0 Step -1
    n = r * NCOL + c
    If alive(n) Then
      bon(b) = 1 : bx(b) = fx + c * ADX : by(b) = fy + r * ADY + 8
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Sub MoveBombs()
  Dim b As Integer, tx As Integer, ty As Integer, t As Integer
  banim = banim + 1
  For b = 0 To 2
    If bon(b) Then
      by(b) = by(b) + 3
      tx = bx(b) + 7 : ty = by(b) + 12
      If ty >= GROW * 8 Then
        bon(b) = 0 : Spr.Hide SL_BOMB + b
      Else
        t = Tiles.At(tx, ty)
        If t >= GfxData.T_SHIELD And t < GfxData.T_SHIELD + 4 Then
          Damage tx, ty, t
          bon(b) = 0 : Spr.Hide SL_BOMB + b
        ElseIf tx >= px + 1 And tx <= px + 14 And ty >= PY + 3 And ty <= PY + 13 Then
          bon(b) = 0 : Spr.Hide SL_BOMB + b
          KillPlayer
        Else
          Spr.Put SL_BOMB + b, bx(b), by(b), GfxData.S_BOMB + ((banim \ 4) And 1), 0
        End If
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Sub KillPlayer()
  pdead = 100
  son = 0 : Spr.Hide SL_SHOT
  Sfx.Play 1, 31, 0, 15, 70, 1
  Sfx.Play 0, 300, 12, 13, 50, 0
End Sub

Sub PlayerDying()
  Dim b As Integer
  pdead = pdead - 1
  If pdead > 20 Then
    Spr.Put SL_PLAYER, px, PY, GfxData.S_PDIE + ((pdead \ 5) And 1), 0
  Else
    Spr.Hide SL_PLAYER
  End If
  If pdead = 0 Then
    lives = lives - 1
    For b = 0 To 2
      bon(b) = 0 : Spr.Hide SL_BOMB + b
    Next
    If lives = 0 Then
      over = 1
    Else
      px = 152
      Spr.Put SL_PLAYER, px, PY, GfxData.S_PLAYER, 0
    End If
    Hud
  End If
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the saucer
Sub MoveSaucer()
  If uon = 0 Then
    utimer = utimer - 1
    If utimer <= 0 And nalive > 7 And pdead = 0 Then
      uon = 1
      If Rnd(2) Then
        ux = 0 : udir = 1
      Else
        ux = 304 : udir = -1
      End If
    End If
    Exit Sub
  End If
  ux = ux + udir
  If ux < 0 Or ux > 304 Then
    uon = 0 : utimer = 900 + Rnd(600) : Spr.Hide SL_SAUCER : Exit Sub
  End If
  Spr.Put SL_SAUCER, ux, 18, GfxData.S_SAUCER, 0
  If (frames And 7) = 0 Then Sfx.Play 2, 120 + (frames And 8) * 6, 0, 9, 6, 0
End Sub

Sub HitSaucer()
  Dim pts As Integer
  pts = Choose(Rnd(4) + 1, 50, 100, 150, 300)
  uon = 0 : utimer = 900 + Rnd(600)
  Spr.Hide SL_SAUCER
  Boom ux, 18
  AddScore pts
  msgx = ux \ 8 : msgt = 60
  If msgx > 36 Then msgx = 36
  Tiles.Text msgx, 3, CStr(pts)
  Sfx.Play 1, 12, -1, 15, 30, 1
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- explosions, messages
Sub Effects()
  If boomt > 0 Then
    boomt = boomt - 1
    If boomt = 0 Then
      Spr.Hide SL_BOOM
    Else
      Spr.Put SL_BOOM, boomx, boomy, GfxData.S_BOOM + ((boomt \ 4) And 1), 0
    End If
  End If
  If msgt > 0 Then
    msgt = msgt - 1
    If msgt = 0 Then Tiles.Text msgx, 3, "   "
  End If
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the end of a game
Sub GameOver()
  Dim n As Integer
  Tiles.Text 15, 15, "GAME  OVER"
  Hud
  For n = 1 To 200
    Frame
    Spr.Show
    Sfx.Update
    If n > 50 And FirePressed() Then Exit For
  Next
  Sfx.Quiet
End Sub

files.name: Nx.cls
files.text:
' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Spr.cls
files.text:
' Spr - the Next's 128 hardware sprites, straight on the ports (#303B slot, #57 attributes).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' 4 bit patterns (GfxData.Load puts them in the sprite RAM), 16 x 16 pixels, scaled 1x - 8x.
' Put / Hide write a table in RAM; Show sends the table to the hardware in one go (do it just
' after Frame, so nothing moves half way down the screen).
' Coordinates are the tilemap's: 0, 0 is the top left of the whole 320 x 256 picture (the
' border included); the 256 x 192 paper is 32 - 287 across, 32 - 223 down. A sprite at x -16 .. or
' y -16 .. wraps (512): keep it hidden instead.
Option Explicit

' flags for Put: add them
Public Const MirrorX = 8
Public Const MirrorY = 4
Public Const Rotate = 2
Public Const Scale2X = &H800
Public Const Scale2Y = &H200
Public Const Scale2 = &HA00
Public Const Scale4X = &H1000
Public Const Scale4Y = &H400
Public Const Scale4 = &H1400
' a palette offset: Pal * n (n 0 - 15: spr_pal.png's row n)
Public Const Pal = 16

Private tab(639) As Byte          ' 128 x 5 attribute bytes
Private used As Integer           ' the highest slot Put + 1 (Show sends that many)

' Init: every sprite hidden, sprites on (over the border too), transparent colour 15
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 639
    tab(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 3 To 639 Step 5
    tab(i) = &H40                ' hidden, but still 5 bytes (the upload stays in step)
  Next
  used = 128
  Show
  used = 0
  Nx.Reg &H4B, &HF               ' 4 bit sprites: colour 15 is transparent
  Nx.Reg &H15, (Nx.RegGet(&H15) And &H1C) Or 3   ' sprites on, over the border; the order kept
End Sub

' Put n, x, y, pattern, flags: sprite n (0-127) at x, y showing pattern (0-127), with flags
' (MirrorX + Scale2 + Pal * 2 ...)
Public Sub Put(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal pattern As Integer, ByVal flags As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld c, a
            inc a
            ld hl, {used}
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sp_low
            ld (hl), a
sp_low:
            ld l, c                 ; DE = tab + n * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab}
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl                  ; x
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 0: x bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; x bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; y
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 1: y bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld b, a                 ; y bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; pattern
            ld a, (hl)
            ex af, af'
            pop hl                  ; flags
            ld a, (hl)
            and #FE
            or c
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 2: palette offset, mirrors, rotate, x bit 8
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; scale bits
            ex af, af'
            ld l, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 3: visible, 5 bytes, pattern bits 6-1
            inc de
            ld a, l
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, c
            and #1E
            or b
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, scale, y bit 8
#endasm
End Sub

' Hide n: sprite n not shown
Public Sub Hide(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), #40            ; not visible, 5 bytes kept (else the upload slips a byte)
#endasm
End Sub

' HideRange first, count: those sprites not shown
Public Sub HideRange(ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, hr_done
            ld b, a
            ex de, hl
            ld de, 5
hr_lp:
            ld (hl), #40
            add hl, de
            djnz hr_lp
hr_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to the hardware (the slots up to the highest one Put)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld a, ({used})
            or a
            jr z, sh_done
            ld bc, #303B
            xor a
            out (c), a
            ld a, ({used})
            ld e, a                 ; E sprites, 5 bytes each
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld c, #57
sh_lp:
            ld b, 5
            otir
            dec e
            jr nz, sh_lp
sh_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Visible(n): True when sprite n is shown
Public Function Visible(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld de, 0
            and #80
            jr z, vi_no
            dec de
vi_no:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Tiles.cls
files.text:
' Tiles - the Next's tilemap as a 4 bit picture: 40 x 32 cells of 8 x 8 pixels over the whole
' 320 x 256 display (the border included), 16 colours (tile_pal.png), colour 15 transparent.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' The map stays where the platform put it (bank 5 + #2000, seen at #E000: one byte a cell, the
' tile number), so Print and Locate still work on it: the font is tiles 32-126 (a character's code
' is its tile). The tile definitions go to bank 5 + #0000 (#C000-#DFFF, 32 bytes a tile): the
' ULA screen's place, so the ULA is turned off. Don't use Mode or Cls after Init (Mode puts the
' platform's own text tiles back; Cls is all right but fills with tile 32).
' Print near the right edge or the last row wraps and scrolls: end prints with ; and keep them
' off row 32 and column 40.
Option Explicit

Public Const Cols = 40
Public Const Rows = 32
Private Const MAPA = &HE000

' Init: the tilemap on, 40 x 32, 4 bit tiles from #C000, no attribute bytes, over the ULA;
' the ULA off; no scroll; the whole picture
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H68, Nx.RegGet(&H68) Or &H80     ' the ULA off (its screen's RAM holds the tiles)
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H20                         ' the map: bank 5 + #2000
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &H0                          ' the tile definitions: bank 5 + #0000
  Nx.Reg &H6C, 0                            ' every cell: palette offset 0, no mirror
  Nx.Reg &H4C, &HF                          ' colour 15 transparent
  Nx.Reg &H2F, 0 : Nx.Reg &H30, 0 : Nx.Reg &H31, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 8                            ' the clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 159 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &HA1                         ' on, 40 x 32, no attributes, 4 bit, over the ULA
End Sub

' Put x, y, t: cell x (0-39), y (0-31) shows tile t
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; y
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; y * 40
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Get(x, y): the tile in cell x, y
Public Function Get(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' At(px, py): the tile under pixel px, py (0-319, 0-255), 0 off the map
Public Function At(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; px
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; py
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, at_off
            ld a, d
            cp 2
            jr nc, at_off
            ld hl, -320
            add hl, de
            jr c, at_off
            srl d                   ; px / 8
            rr e
            srl e
            srl e
            ld a, c
            and #F8                 ; (py / 8) * 8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, bc              ; (py / 8) * 40
            ld d, #E0
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            jr at_set
at_off:
            ld e, 0
at_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fill t: every cell tile t
Public Sub Fill(ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 40 * 32 - 1
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t: a block of cells
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Text x, y, s: text from cell x, y (the font tiles), no wrap, no scroll
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
tx_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, tx_done
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            ld a, d
            cp #E5                  ; past the map's end (#E500)
            jr nc, tx_done
            jr tx_lp
tx_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Scroll x, y: the tilemap moved by x (0-319) and y (0-255) pixels
Public Sub Scroll(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H2F, (x \ 256) And 3
  Nx.Reg &H30, x And 255
  Nx.Reg &H31, y And 255
End Sub

files.name: Sfx.cls
files.text:
' Sfx - sound effects on the Next's AY chip (the first of its three), straight on the ports:
' #FFFD picks a register, #BFFD writes it. Three channels, each playing one effect at a time:
' a tone or noise whose pitch slides and whose volume fades to nothing over its length.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Call Update once a frame (50 a second).
'   Sfx.Play 0, 200, 8, 15, 12, 0     ' channel A: tone period 200, rising pitch... 12 frames
Option Explicit

Private per(2) As Integer         ' the tone period now (12 bits; noise: 0-31)
Private slide(2) As Integer       ' added to it each frame
Private vol(2) As Integer         ' the volume it starts at (0-15)
Private total(2) As Integer       ' its length in frames
Private left(2) As Integer        ' frames to go (0 = silent)
Private nse(2) As Integer         ' 1 = noise, 0 = tone
Private mix As Integer

Private Sub W(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #FFFD
            out (c), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, #BF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Init: AY 1 picked (the Next has three: Turbosound), every channel quiet
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  Out &HFFFD, &HFF                 ' AY 1 (Turbosound: #FF, #FE, #FD pick the chips)
  For i = 0 To 13
    W i, 0
  Next
  W 7, &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
  Next
End Sub

' Play ch, period, slidePerFrame, volume, frames, noise: start an effect on channel ch (0-2)
Public Sub Play(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal period As Integer, ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal volume As Integer, ByVal frames As Integer, ByVal noise As Integer)
  If ch < 0 Or ch > 2 Then Exit Sub
  per(ch) = period : slide(ch) = sl : vol(ch) = volume : total(ch) = frames : left(ch) = frames : nse(ch) = noise
End Sub

' Busy(ch): True while channel ch plays
Public Function Busy(ByVal ch As Integer) As Integer
  Busy = (left(ch) > 0)
End Function

' Update: once a frame - the pitches slide, the volumes fade, the AY written
Public Sub Update()
  Dim i As Integer, v As Integer, p As Integer
  mix = &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    If left(i) > 0 Then
      v = (vol(i) * left(i) + total(i) - 1) \ total(i)
      p = per(i)
      If nse(i) Then
        W 6, p And 31
        mix = mix And Not (8 * (2 ^ i))
      Else
        W i * 2, p And 255
        W i * 2 + 1, (p \ 256) And 15
        mix = mix And Not (2 ^ i)
      End If
      W 8 + i, v
      per(i) = per(i) + slide(i)
      If per(i) < 1 Then per(i) = 1
      left(i) = left(i) - 1
    Else
      W 8 + i, 0
    End If
  Next
  W 7, mix
End Sub

' Quiet: every channel stopped
Public Sub Quiet()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
    W 8 + i, 0
  Next
End Sub

            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl

            add hl, hl

            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
